articles.title: After the violence and chaos in France, there’s only one beneficiary: Marine Le Pen | Paul Taylor
articles.summary:
The far-right leader’s promise to restore order will appeal to many ahead of next year’s presidential elections – the stakes are suddenly much higher

There is only one clear winner so far from France’s chaos: Marine Le Pen. The violence and rioting that engulfed towns and cities across the country over the weekend, six months before a pivotal presidential election, is a godsend for the hard-right, Eurosceptical, anti-immigration candidate. As buildings burned, shops were looted and police attacked, the rioting largely drowned out peaceful mass protests over the dilapidated state of schools , fuel prices and the cost of living.

Across France and the rest of Europe, people are in shock at scenes of arson and pillage in city centres, the wrecking of symbols of the republic such as the 19th-century town hall in peaceful provincial Limoges and the bust of Marianne in Marseille’s city hall, and the looting of more than 2,000 shops.

Paul Taylor is a senior visiting fellow at the European Policy Centre

articles.title: Do not be distracted by global crises. Nature cannot wait for a better year – we must act now | Steven Guilbeault
articles.summary:
In 2022, I helped push through the international agreement to protect biodiversity. Wars and economic pressures can make nature seem like a ‘nice-to-have’. But it is a critical asset, and Cop17 must deliver real action

When I was five, property developers came to cut down the woods behind my home in La Tuque, Quebec. My mother encouraged me to climb one of the trees in protest, then told the developers, straight-faced, that there was nothing she could do when they asked her to get me down. A few days later, the tree was cut down anyway.

I thought about that tree in the early hours of a freezing Montreal morning in December 2022, as the gavel came down on a global agreement between nearly 200 countries to halt and reverse the loss of nature by 2030. I thought about how important nature is for our health, our food security and our economies, but also how much passion there is around protecting it, and how it has the power to inspire people all around the world.

articles.title: US gave us no warning of Russian strikes on Kyiv power plants, Zelenskyy says
articles.summary:
Ukrainian president accuses Washington of ‘denial of reality’ in continuing row with Trump over apparent support for Moscow

Ukraine did not receive a warning from the US about an impending Russian missile attack on Sunday evening, Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said, reviving concerns that Washington is withholding intelligence to bully Kyiv into capitulating to Moscow.

Yuri Ihnat, a spokesperson for the Ukrainian air force, said on television on Monday morning that Ukraine had not received a warning before a Russian missile barrage hit power plants in Kyiv at about 11pm. Earlier, a Ukrainian government official had told the Guardian the US had not warned the capital about the impending missile strike.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v Evropě a jejím okolí je nadále vysoce napjatá po incidentech s drony v černomořských vodách poblíž Rumunska a eskalaci útoků na energetickou infrastrukturu na Ukrajině. V EU probíhají ostré spory o sedmiletý rozpočet, daňové zátěže a klimatické politiky, což prohlubuje politickou nestabilitu. Roste také tlak na zvládání vysokých cen energií, které pohánějí populistické tendence napříč členskými státy.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in and around Europe remains highly tense following drone incidents in Black Sea waters near Romania and escalating strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure. Sharp disputes over the seven-year EU budget, tax burdens, and climate policies are deepening political instability within the bloc. Rising pressure to manage high energy prices is also fueling populist tendencies across member states.

archive.forecast_en: Continued market nervousness is expected in the coming days due to security incidents in the Black Sea and ongoing debates over the EU budget.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropská unie čelí stupňujícímu se tlaku na energetických trzích, napětí v Černém moři po útocích dronů na tankery a složitým vyjednáváním o sedmiletém rozpočtu. Rétorika USA ohledně války na Ukrajině a možného uvolnění sankcí na ruskou 'stínovou flotilu' prohlubuje obavy o jednotu západní aliance a stabilitu dodávek energií.
archive.security_status_en: The European Union faces escalating pressure in energy markets, tensions in the Black Sea following drone attacks on tankers, and complex negotiations over the seven-year budget. U.S. rhetoric regarding the war in Ukraine and the potential easing of sanctions on Russia's 'shadow fleet' deepens concerns over Western alliance unity and energy supply stability.

archive.forecast_en: Continued volatility in energy markets and escalating diplomatic pressure to reach a compromise on the EU budget are expected in the coming days.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropská unie čelí rostoucímu napětí kvůli kolapsu energetického příměří na Ukrajině a patové situaci na summitu ohledně dlouhodobého rozpočtu a dodávek plynu. Mezitím geopolitické tlaky ze strany USA a eskalující konflikty vyvíjejí silný tlak na evropskou ekonomickou stabilitu i bezpečnostní architekturu.
archive.security_status_en: The European Union is facing mounting tension due to the collapse of the energy ceasefire in Ukraine and a deadlock at the summit regarding the long-term budget and gas supplies. Meanwhile, geopolitical pressures from the US and escalating conflicts place severe strain on European economic stability and security architecture.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropská unie čelí rostoucímu vnitřnímu napětí kvůli rozporům ohledně rozpočtu, migrace a energetické politiky, kterou komplikuje americko-ruská dohoda o dodávkách paliv. Rusko pokračuje v konfiskaci evropských aktiv a Ukrajina obnovila útoky na ruské ropné rafinérie, což vyvolalo ostrou kritiku ze strany USA. Současně se hromadí sociální nepokoje a protesty mladých či hnutí žlutých vest ve Francii, zatímco na vnějších hranicích EU přetrvává silný migrační tlak.
archive.security_status_en: The European Union is facing rising internal tensions over budget disputes, migration, and energy policy, further complicated by a US-Russia fuel supply deal. Russia continues to seize European assets and Ukraine has resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries, drawing sharp criticism from the US. Simultaneously, social unrest and youth and Yellow Vest protests are mounting in France, while strong migratory pressure persists at the EU's external borders.

archive.forecast_en: Persistent tensions in energy markets and further diplomatic clashes between the US and the EU over renewed oil refinery strikes are expected in the coming days. Internal stability is further strained by social unrest in France and Albania, surging French bond yields approaching 5%, and intensifying political momentum for stricter migration controls.

archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, continued diplomatic friction between the US and EU regarding Ukraine and heightened pressure to address the French budgetary crisis are expected. Social tensions and security incidents will continue to occupy EU leaders.

Simultaneously, the EU is grappling with internal economic pressures, agreements on automotive subsidy rules, and mounting concerns over energy and migration.

Meanwhile, Italy successfully negotiated an EU deal to lower electricity prices, while a French-German auto agreement protects domestic manufacturers.
archive.forecast_cs: V následujících dnech se očekávají intenzivní jednání na úrovni EU o náhradě americké satelitní a finanční podpory pro Ukrajinu a reakce na vývoj amerických sankcí vůči Rusku.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vlně vnitřních i vnějších otřesů, dominuje hluboká politická a bezpečnostní krize ve Francii poznamenaná rozsáhlými nepokoji, útoky na veřejný pořádek a výprodejem francouzských dluhopisů. Na východě mezitím pokračuje eskalace války na Ukrajině, kde Kyiv hlásí bezprecedentní použití dronů a roste napětí kolem americké politiky vůči Rusku.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of internal and external shocks, dominated by a deep political and security crisis in France marked by widespread riots, attacks on public order, and a sell-off in French bonds. Meanwhile, the escalation of the war in Ukraine continues in the east, where Kyiv reports unprecedented drone usage and tensions rise over US policy towards Russia.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující bezpečnostní opatření a curfews ve francouzských městech a nervozitu na dluhopisových trzích. Diplomatické napětí mezi Evropou a USA ohledně strategie vůči Ukrajině zůstane na vysoké úrovni.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, continued security measures and curfews in French cities and nervousness in bond markets are expected. Diplomatic tensions between Europe and the US regarding the strategy toward Ukraine will remain high.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí akutním vnitřním i vnějším tlakům. Vážné nepokoje a rabování ve Francii a Itálii vedou k nasazení armády a vyvolávají výprodeje na dluhopisových trzích, zatímco prohlubující se neshody mezi USA a Ukrajinou ohledně dodávek raket a zpravodajských informací zvyšují geopolitické napětí.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing acute internal and external pressures. Severe riots and looting in France and Italy are prompting military deployments and sparking sell-offs in bond markets, while deepening rifts between the US and Ukraine regarding missile deliveries and intelligence sharing heighten geopolitical tensions.
archive.forecast_cs: V následujících dnech lze očekávat přetrvávající napětí na finančních trzích kvůli francouzským a italským nepokojům a pokračující diplomatické třenice ohledně Ukrajiny. Bezpečnostní opatření ve velkých městech zůstanou posílena.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, persistent tension in financial markets is expected due to the French and Italian unrest, alongside ongoing diplomatic friction regarding Ukraine. Security measures in major cities will remain heightened.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci vnitřních sociálních nepokojů a přetrvávajícího geopolitického napětí. Francie zavádí noční zákazy vycházení na uklidnění situace, zatímco diplomatická jednání mezi USA, evropskými lídrzy a Ukrajinou hledají řešení konfliktu navzdory rostoucím třenicím v oblasti sdílení zpravodajských informací.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces a combination of domestic social unrest and persistent geopolitical tension. France is implementing nighttime curfews to stabilize the situation, while diplomatic talks between the US, European leaders, and Ukraine seek conflict resolution despite growing intelligence-sharing frictions.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat postupné zklidňování situace ve francouzských městech díky zavedeným zákazům vycházení, avšak diplomatická diskuse o podpoře Ukrajiny a napětí v USA zůstanou klíčovými tématy.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, the situation in French cities is expected to gradually stabilize thanks to imposed curfews, while diplomatic talks regarding Ukraine support and US tensions remain central themes.
